recipes.name: Zested Up Shin Black Ramen
ingredients: 1 package (130g) Shin Black Ramen (use noodles and seasoning packet)
½ cup (112g) leftover meat (I used cooked ground pork)
instructions: Cook the ramen to package directions.
To make the 6 minute egg, boil an egg for 6 minutes, shock it in an ice bath, and then peel it before slicing carefully and placing on your ramen.
Top your ramen with thinly sliced green onion and the cooked protein of your choice. I used reheated leftover sautéed ground pork.
